description: A woman in a jewelled crown with a cross and pearl veil sits alone on a gold-and-red jewelled throne, holding a sceptre in her right hand and a golden orb with a cross in her left. She wears an ornate embroidered gold and jewel-studded robe. Around her, men in dark robes kneel and bow with their heads down, and armoured guards with spears stand in the background. The setting is a dim vaulted hall with gilded mosaic arches, stone columns and lit torches. No text, numbers or frame are visible.
